scientific_limitations: Nonzero rank-one algebraic Nijenhuis endomorphisms of free class-two nilpotent Lie algebras only.
Distinct linear operators are counted, not factorization pairs or conjugacy orbits.
Finite exhaustive checks do not replace the general proof; no higher-rank or nonreduced-scheme classification.
Unindexed equivalent classifications remain a publication-priority risk.
title: Rank-one Nijenhuis spectra of free two-step nilpotent Lie algebras
